holdout.suite: original + 51 weighted variants + 2 unweighted diagnostic masks, unchanged e1_transforms.conditions()
holdout.bootstrap_unit: source group; identical paired draws for both members and ensemble
holdout.adaptation: NONE. Report all results as-is, regardless of performance. No threshold, seed, member, loss, epoch, augmentation, averaging or calibration change.
holdout.failure: Mark readout started before first H decode. Interrupted readout without committed predictions stops for a documented functional repair; no automatic rerun. Completed immutable predictions may be reanalyzed without model reevaluation. Never unseal H to diagnose low performance.

functional_failure_policy: Fail closed for hash, identity, decoding, finite-value, row, replay or environment errors. Preserve attempts and all outputs. Before H, interrupted fits restart identical original initialization. After H, all-data interruption may restart the identical fixed fit only. A code-only repair requires a new version and an explicit incident record; H cannot justify scientific changes. No fallback to a better-looking procedure.
sanity_gate: All-data checkpoints finite, correct architectures/shapes and identity, full pool-only fixture rows/IDs and finite [0,1] probabilities, labels match fixed threshold, reload/replay verified. No in-sample AUC or accuracy threshold and no generalization claim.

release.fallback: Enable CUDA-unavailable CPU fallback only if exact final bundle CPU pass valid, <=1200s, max score difference <=1e-5 and zero label flips. Verify actual CUDA-unavailable auto path in a separate bounded process against CPU CSV bytes. Otherwise default requires CUDA; explicit CPU diagnostics remain possible. Never catch arbitrary CUDA runtime failures.
release.cache: Fresh processes, OS file cache not cleared. Not disk-cold timing.
release.timing_claim: Measured 5060 Ti only. T4 remains unverified.
release.undecodable_policy: Fail visibly with offending filename, no missing-row success, placeholder probabilities, silent filtering or PIL truncated-image permissiveness. Replace an existing CSV atomically only after complete successful inference, with a stderr notice. On failure preserve previous bytes and exit nonzero; previous CSV is not evidence of success.

local_boundary: Prepare archive with 5950 pool bytes and metadata only. Explicit future launcher invocation adds 1050 H bytes from known paths and verifies recorded hashes without decoding. Local dry-run never reads/stats H paths. No test files.
selection_limits: All P folds informed adaptive development. Conditional bootstrap intervals do not correct selection or measure training variance. H tests the frozen full-pool procedure, not the later all-data weight realization.
revision: X1 selection: Swin-S replaces Swin-T. Recipe, loss, seed, inference numerics, judge interface, four fits, one H readout and release gates unchanged from final-v2. Final-v2 remains intact and unlaunched.

inference_interface.batch_size: Accept positive integer --batch_size; always compute batch64; warn if another value was requested.
inference_interface.workers: Accept nonnegative integer --workers; always compute with zero workers; warn if another value was requested.
inference_interface.threshold: Accept finite --threshold in [0,1]; always write labels using frozen0.5; warn if another value was requested.
inference_interface.existing_output: Atomic replacement on successful complete inference. stderr notice before replacement; old bytes remain intact if inference or replacement fails.
release_invocations: alias --batch_size16 --workers1 --threshold0.9 on existing output; frozen0.5 still used
